tables: Observable-based eligibility. A hidden target alone does not make a semantic attack a side channel.
A single result record. Only fields relevant to the requested comparison must align; unavailable required fields remain unresolved.
Comparison rules. A known mismatch and a missing binding have different consequences.
Filled record and its licensed judgment. Values are source-reported; no cross-mode effect is computed.
Deployment judgments, positive reuse conditions and applicable boundaries. Direct evidence tests the named branch; extensions address a different mechanism, mode or component.

Defense types and the evidence available for choosing them. These representative conditions span confidentiality, attribution and human--agent detection; their outcomes are not a common efficacy ranking.
Six checks over 16 evaluated-mitigation families. Counts apply to the source-scoped claim; no composite quality score is computed.

Controlled placement results. Panel A accuracy uses 24 held-out outputs from 12 topic pairs; byte means use all 48 outputs. Attacks are fitted separately per arm/link. Panel B replays the same 24 Luna plans. State equality is relative to each task's no-cover final state.
Executed native queries. S1 retains the full export accounting; Q4 was issued only on IEEE and not exported in the original acquisition.
Reading key for the supplied records. Prose uses full meanings; codes support joins.
S1

Historical route accounting for the original October 8, 2026 snapshot, including its later source checks. Counts overlap and do not form a complete PRISMA flow; the October 21 supplementary round is reported separately.
S2
Executed native queries and saved export occurrences. IEEE dates: October 8, 2026; ACM query/partition acquisition: October 8--9, 2026. Counts are not included study families.
S3
Filled record and its licensed judgment. Values are source-reported; no cross-mode effect is computed.
S4

Primary observable/receiver profile $\times $ signal origin in the 43{} core families of the original October 8, 2026 snapshot. Column $n$ counts distinct families; each family occupies one profile row but may have multiple origins. Origin cells count families, not results, and therefore need not sum to $n$. Extra observer views remain in the snapshot ledger. Later additions are outside this map; zeros are not field-wide gaps.
S5
From prior cross-layer systematizations to result-level deployment decisions: the specific comparison object and its demonstrated use.
S6

Source--receiver--intervention map. The target column distinguishes content/property inference, attribution and human--agent distinction; none alone establishes an unauthorized privacy violation. U denotes an unresolved source/run binding.
S7
Dependency--holdout--claim map. Each row excludes one explanation, not all confounding.
S8

Fixed-archive predictive evidence and matched support. Units: nats of question-weighted loss reduction. Positive values favor the second program. Intervals condition on fitted programs; the original and additive-control allocations remain separate.
S9

Public-trace permission projection. ``Site'' means its own document only; it does not authenticate cross-document capture. Full field-level CSV and one complete ingested-record projection are supplemental.
Post-review H2 controls. Positive values denote a question-mean log-loss reduction (nats); brackets are conditional 98.333\% resampling intervals. Not a new agent run.

Additive failure/activity diagnostics on all 1,135 test rows/226 questions. Point scores use the original question weights; no new confirmatory intervals. Original programs are read from saved probabilities, not refitted.
Quantitative assertions excluded for missing bindings.

Scoped intervention dispositions for the 43{} core families in the original October 8, 2026 snapshot. Categories are mutually exclusive at family level, not a count of successful defenses; later additions are outside this inventory.
Load-bearing source ablation within the original 60-family snapshot. Entries identify its actual dependence; S9/S10 report subsequent controlled evidence and source expansion separately.
Descriptive comparison within declared subsets. Percentages have the displayed row denominator, not all 528 pairs.
Six checks over 16 evaluated-mitigation families. Counts apply to the source-scoped claim; no composite quality score is computed.
Disposition flow for the completed 565-record frame. Source-scoped examination is not synonymous with new core inclusion.
